async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Select a project from the expanded menu
    await page.get_by_role("menuitem", name="Primer / design", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Fill in the milestone details
    # Title field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=True).fill("cleaning sensitive information")

    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Start date", exact=True).fill("2023-02-16")
    # Due date field (end date)
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date", exact=True).fill("2023-03-08")
    
    # Step 3: Save the milestone
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create milestone", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Return a success message
    return "Milestone 'cleaning sensitive information' created successfully with start date 2023-02-16 and end date 2023-03-08."
